source: ESPN site.web.api.espn.com byathlete (per game) + site.api.espn.com injuries

Mouhamed Gueye.comment: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

Henri Veesaar.comment: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

Devin Carter.comment: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

Tyler Bilodeau.comment: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Saturday's game in Cleveland.

Grant Williams.comment: Williams (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

Coby White.comment: White (calf) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

Kon Knueppel.comment: Knueppel (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Hawks.

Kylan Boswell.comment: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

Nic Claxton.comment: Claxton (hamstring) will be re-evaluated in two weeks, K.C. Johnson of Chicago Sports Network reports.

Cooper Flagg.comment: Flagg exited to the locker room in the second quarter of Friday's game against Indiana due to an apparent left shoulder injury, Grant Afseth of DallasHoopsJournal.com reports.

Jett Howard.comment: Howard (calf) is out for Friday's game in Indiana.

Caleb Martin.comment: Martin (thumb) has been ruled out for Fridays' game against the Pacers.

Santi Aldama.comment: Aldama (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

Tarik Biberovic.comment: Biberovic (heel) is out for Friday's game against Indiana.

Dereck Lively II.comment: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

Spencer Jones.comment: Jones (hamstring) is out for Saturday's game against the Pelicans.

Cameron Johnson.comment: Johnson (ankle) has been ruled out for Saturday's game against New Orleans.

Alpha Diallo.comment: Diallo is questionable for Saturday's game versus the Pelicans due to a right wrist sprain.

Julian Strawther.comment: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

Charles Bassey.comment: Bassey (knee) is out for Friday's game versus the Grizzlies.

Kristaps Porzingis.comment: Porzingis is contemplating his future in basketball as he deals with recurring symptoms from the autoimmune condition termed as postural orthostatic tachycardia syndrome, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Moses Moody.comment: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

Jimmy Butler III.comment: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

Reed Sheppard.comment: Sheppard (knee) is out for Friday's game in San Antonio.

Steven Adams.comment: Adams (calf) is questionable to play in Friday's game against the Spurs.

Ben Sheppard.comment: Sheppard has been diagnosed with a torn meniscus in his left knee and is without a timetable for a return to game action, Scott Agness of FieldhouseFiles.com reports.

T.J. McConnell.comment: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against Dallas.

Johnny Furphy.comment: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

Bradley Beal.comment: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

Max Strus.comment: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

Yanic Konan Niederhauser.comment: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

Brandon Ingram.comment: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

Jordan Miller.comment: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

Jake LaRavia.comment: LaRavia (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Clippers, Mark Medina of TheSportingTribune.com reports.

Adou Thiero.comment: Thiero (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

Cameron Carr.comment: Carr (oblique) is out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

Cedric Coward.comment: Coward is doubtful for Friday's game against the Warriors due to a left wrist sprain.

Isaiah Stewart.comment: Stewart (ankle) is questionable for Friday's game against the Warriors.

Donte DiVincenzo.comment: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

Otega Oweh.comment: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.

Nikola Topic.comment: Topic (back) won't play in Thursday's game against the Nuggets.

Thomas Sorber.comment: Sorber (knee) is listed as out for Thursday's game against Denver.

Paolo Banchero.comment: Banchero ended with 35 points (10-12 FG, 3-4 3Pt, 12-16 FT), seven rebounds, 10 assists and one steal over 41 minutes in Wednesday's 132-125 loss to Atlanta.

Anthony Black.comment: Black (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Minnesota but participated in shootaround and has experienced no setbacks in his recovery, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Jonathan Isaac.comment: Isaac (knee) is out for Friday's game against Minnesota.

Noah Penda.comment: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

Izaiyah Nelson.comment: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

Tacko Fall.comment: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

Dean Wade.comment: Wade is listed as questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks due to a left ankle sprain.

LeBron James.comment: James (back) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Bucks.

Dominick Barlow.comment: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

Ariel Hukporti.comment: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Luke Kennard.comment: Kennard (knee) is questionable to play Saturday against the Warriors.

Oso Ighodaro.comment: Ighodaro (oblique) is listed as doubtful for Saturday's game against Golden State.

Mark Williams.comment: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

Branden Carlson.comment: Carlson (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against Sacramento.

Chris Youngblood.comment: Youngblood (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Kings.

Shaedon Sharpe.comment: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

Ben Simmons.comment: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

Dylan Cardwell.comment: Cardwell (calf) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, with a longer absence possible, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

Maxime Raynaud.comment: Raynaud (knee) is expected to miss at least the first five or six games of the regular season, and potentially longer, Frankie Cartoscelli of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

Tobias Harris.comment: Harris (calf) is out for Friday's game against the Rockets.

Jayden Quaintance.comment: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

Nate Bittle.comment: Bittle (foot) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Bulls.

Trey Alexander.comment: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

Jusuf Nurkic.comment: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

AJ Dybantsa.comment: Dybantsa (ankle) is out for Friday's game against the Raptors, Josh Robbins of The Athletic reports.

Tristan Vukcevic.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

Jamir Watkins.comment: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.
